display_information.name: DebateKit
display_information.description: Your AI Board of Directors — multi-model AI brainstorming directly in Slack
display_information.long_description:
DebateKit brings collaborative AI brainstorming to Slack. Consult GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, and 200+ AI models on any question — directly from your channels.

How it works:
1. Ask a question with /debatekit or @DebateKit
2. Multiple AI models discuss your question sequentially
3. A moderator AI synthesizes all perspectives into actionable insight

Commands:
- /debatekit [question] — General brainstorming and consultation
- /debatekit-review [code or description] — Expert code reviews and architecture assessments
- @DebateKit in any channel — Start a multi-model discussion
- Direct Message — Private AI council sessions

Features:
- 200+ AI models including GPT-4o, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, Llama, Mistral, and more
- Three thinking levels: low (fast/cheap), medium (balanced), high (maximum reasoning)
- Structured output with moderator synthesis and individual model perspectives
- Slack AI Assistant integration with suggested prompts
- View full results in the DebateKit web app

Setup:
1. Install the app to your workspace
2. Get an API key at debatekit.com/chat/settings/api-keys
3. Configure it in the DebateKit App Home tab

Learn more at debatekit.com
